sites.name: Maasai Mara National Reserve
sites.description: World-famous for the Great Migration of wildebeest and zebra. Home to the Big Five and rich Maasai culture.
sites.best_time_to_visit: July to October during the Great Migration and dry season.
sites.accessibility: 4-5 hour drive from Nairobi or 45-minute flight.

sites.name: Amboseli National Park
sites.description: Famous for large elephant herds and spectacular views of Mount Kilimanjaro.
sites.best_time_to_visit: June to October during the dry season.

sites.name: Tsavo East National Park
sites.description: Kenya's largest national park known for red elephants, maneless lions, and Lugard Falls.
sites.best_time_to_visit: June to September during the dry season.
sites.accessibility: 5-6 hour drive from Nairobi or 1-hour flight.

sites.name: Lamu Island
sites.description: UNESCO World Heritage site with Swahili culture, car-free streets, and historic architecture.
sites.best_time_to_visit: December to January and July to August.
sites.accessibility: 1.5-hour flight from Nairobi followed by boat transfer.

sites.name: Diani Beach
sites.description: Award-winning white sand beach with coral reefs and crystal-clear waters.
sites.best_time_to_visit: December to February and July to August.
sites.accessibility: 1-hour flight from Nairobi to Ukunda Airstrip.

sites.name: Lake Nakuru National Park
sites.description: Famous for flamingos and rhino sanctuary in the Rift Valley.
sites.best_time_to_visit: June to September and January to February.

sites.name: Mount Kenya National Park
sites.description: Africa's second-highest mountain with trekking routes and alpine scenery.
sites.best_time_to_visit: January to February and August to September.
sites.accessibility: 3-hour drive from Nairobi to the base towns.

sites.name: Hell's Gate National Park
sites.description: Unique park allowing walking and cycling among wildlife with dramatic cliffs and gorges.
sites.best_time_to_visit: June to August and January to February.

sites.name: Samburu National Reserve
sites.description: Remote reserve famous for the Samburu Special Five and cultural experiences.
sites.best_time_to_visit: June to September and January to February.

sites.name: Nairobi National Park
sites.description: Unique wildlife park located within Nairobi city with lions, rhinos, and city skyline views.
sites.best_time_to_visit: July to September and January to February.
sites.accessibility: 15-30 minute drive from Nairobi city centre.

sites.name: Watamu Marine National Park
sites.description: Protected marine park with coral gardens, sea turtles, and excellent snorkeling.
sites.best_time_to_visit: December to February and July to August.
sites.accessibility: Flight to Malindi followed by 30-minute drive.

sites.name: Lake Naivasha
sites.description: Freshwater Rift Valley lake known for hippos, birds, and Crescent Island walking safaris.
sites.best_time_to_visit: July to August and December to January.
